scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @iocl/web" "npm run dev -w @iocl/api"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @iocl/shared && npm run build -w @iocl/api && npm run build -w @iocl/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @iocl/api && npm run lint -w @iocl/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @iocl/shared && npm run typecheck -w @iocl/api && npm run typecheck -w @iocl/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w @iocl/shared && npm run test -w @iocl/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @iocl/shared
